policy: Unavailable real targets are evidence gaps, never skipped passes. Desktop/server artifacts alone do not cover LazyCat, deployed Pages, mobile devices, or native soft keyboards.

gaps.required: Physical iOS/Android layout, coarse pointer, keys bar and native soft-keyboard evidence at 360/560/820px where applicable.
Build and install the Go LazyCat package on a real box; validate manifest injects, upstream image matching and LPK size against the recorded Rust LPK anchors.
Run responsive and WS acceptance against the actual deployed Pages URL; a local Vite build is not deployment evidence.
Install the produced NSIS/DMG on their real target OS versions and document signing/notarization and WebView2/WKWebView runtime results.
